newsitem.title: USA: IADB lends Peru $235.5 mln to restructure debt.
newsitem.headline: IADB lends Peru $235.5 mln to restructure debt.

text.p: The Inter-American Development Bank said Tuesday it had signed a $235.5 million dollar loan for Peru to as part of an $800 million dollar package to help the country restructure its external debt.
Earlier this month, Peru signed with the International Monetary Fund for a $223 million loan under the same package, designed to halve some $8 billion of Peru's foreign debt.
Other lenders include the World Bank and the Export-Import Bank of Japan, an IADB statement said.
It said the Brady-type plan would cut debt and debt servicing burdens through rate recalculations, overdue interest payments, buyback options and debt-for-bond swaps.
